title: File Store Source
description: File Store source. Streams files from the account-scoped RocketRide file store (users/<client_id>/files/) into the pipeline as raw objects for downstream processing.
Point it at a file to process just that file, or at a folder to process every file in it; enable 'Recursive' to also descend into subfolders.
The client id is resolved from the ROCKETRIDE_CLIENT_ID env var injected by the task engine.

filesystem.path.title: Path
filesystem.path.description: File or folder to process, relative to the account file store root. A folder processes every file directly inside it.

filesystem.recursive.title: Recursive
filesystem.recursive.description: When the path is a folder, also process all files in its subfolders.
